name: field-tracker
description: TMI-103 IoT Animal Tracking Collar — Capacitor Android wrapper

scripts.cap:add:android: npm run build && node node_modules/@capacitor/cli/bin/capacitor add android
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && node node_modules/@capacitor/cli/bin/capacitor sync android
scripts.apk:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cd .. && node scripts/export-apk.cjs
